android.desc:
Sunclock is an astronomical clock that displays not only civil time but also the times of sunrise and sunset and the various phases of twilight. It thus provides you with an accurate picture of the natural course of the day. 

However, the app offers more than just a display of the current time: it also allows you to measure time in various historical and cultural systems used in civilizations such as the Byzantine Empire, the Roman Empire, Judaism, and Islam. This gives you an insight into the different methods of measuring time used by different cultures, from the Horae Temporales to the Liturgy of the Hours to Zmanim and Salāt.

Sunclock is a useful tool for photographers. Based on your location and the date, it calculates the optimal lighting conditions, such as the golden and blue hours and twilight. This allows photographers to take advantage of the best lighting conditions for their shots.

The app also provides accurate times for moonrise, moonset, and moon phases. It also allows you to simulate celestial events, enabling precise observation of the night sky.

Sunclock is fully customizable and can be designed according to your individual preferences. There are various clock designs to choose from, including analog, digital, or zodiac styles. Colors and layouts can also be customized. The app offers a unique and flexible perception of time and can be used in different ways: as an interactive widget, as a live wallpaper, or as a standalone application.

Sunclock is the ideal solution for anyone interested in time, culture, and astronomy. The device features automatic or manual location detection and offers cross-platform support. Whether you are a photographer, history buff, spiritual seeker, or simply fascinated by the vastness of the cosmos, Sunclock helps you experience time in a whole new way.
